title: Nobl Launches AR Series: Its Lightest Road Rims to Date
content:
Nobl Wheels has launched the AR Series, its lightest road rims to date. Available in 40mm and 50mm depths, the AR40 and AR50 combine Nobl’s aerodynamic teardrop profiles, 25mm internal widths and fully hooked beads, with rim weights starting at just 350g.

Nobl AR Wheels Quick Hits

  • AR40
    • Rim Weight 350g
    • Wheelsets as light as 1124g
    • Depth 40mm
    • Internal Width 25mm
    • External Width 31.5mm
    • Widest Point 33.5mm
    • Hole Count 24h
    • Size 700c
    • Strength Rating 110J
    • Max Tire Pressure 80psi
    • Tire Size 28-45c
  • AR50
    • Rim Weight 380g
    • Wheelsets as light as 1184g
    • Depth 50mm
    • Internal Width  25mm
    • External Width  31.5mm
    • Widest Point  33.5mm
    • Hole Count 24h
    • Size 700c
    • Strength Rating 115J
    • Max Tire Pressure 80psi
    • Tire Size 28-45c

Nobl’s Take on All-Road

Road tires are getting wider. Riders want the grip and comfort of 30–32mm tires without giving up the speed and responsiveness of a dedicated road wheel. The AR Series was developed around that balance. Its 25mm internal width creates a supportive tire profile, while a fully hooked bead offers broad tire compatibility. The result is a lightweight platform built for everything from weekday training and local racing to long days on mixed surfaces. The AR Series carries forward Nobl’s aerodynamic teardrop rim profile, first introduced on the Far gravel race wheels. With a 33.5mm widest external point, the AR’s profile maintains an aerodynamic shape. It meets the rule of 105 with a 30c tire, which measures about 32mm on the AR’s 25mm internal width.

Lightweight, Strong, Versatile

By using T1000 carbon and advanced layup processes, AR Series rims are among the lightest and strongest 25mm internal road rims with a hooked bead. With complete wheelsets starting at just 1124 grams, you get the security of a hooked bead at the same weight or less than hookless rivals. The AR40 starts at just 350g. Despite its low weight, the rim has passed impact testing up to 110J. The deeper AR50 weighs 380g per rim and has a 115J impact rating. Both models feature a 25mm internal width and fully hooked beads, and are ready for tires from 28–45c at up to 80 psi.
